review_candidates.title: SME, Primary Engineering, Energy and Infrastructure Projects (Puerto Rico)
review_candidates.description: JOB TITLE: SME, Primary Engineering, Energy and Infrastructure Projects (Puerto Rico) LOCATION: Puerto Rico (Hybrid) Who we are? Built on more than a century of innovation and decades of substation expertise, Linxon blends AtkinsRéalis' project management strength with Hitachi Energy's technological leadership. Together, we deliver high‑performing EPC solutions that strengthen the power grid. We support community growth and industrial development by providing end‑to‑end engineering, procurement, management, and construction services for complex AC substation and electrification projects across five core markets. What We Believe? We believe in the value of every client's'investment and take pride in tackling challenging, high‑risk projects. With deep expertise and continuous development, our teams operate with the precision, resilience, and mission‑focus needed to deliver crucial infrastructure—often described as the "special forces" of our industry. To learn more about us click on the links below: Careers - Linxon Building the infrastructure to power the world - we are Linxon! (youtube.com) How will you make your impact? As the Subject Matter Expert, Primary Engineering at Linxon, you will be at the forefront of transforming the energy landscape across the Americas. In this pivotal role, you will apply your technical mastery to develop innovative Substation Layout Designs spanning 765kV to 11kV, directly contributing to the modernization, resiliency, and sustainability of the power grid. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary experts—Project Lead Engineers, BIM Engineers, Protection & Control Engineers, and Civil Engineers—collectively shaping solutions that enable reliable energy access, support the integration of renewables, and strengthen critical infrastructure for future generations. Your insights won't just support projects; they will influence how communities and industries stay powered in a rapidly evolving energy world. While this is an individual contributor position, it is intentionally built for someone ready to grow into a leadership path. With demonstrated performance and vision, you can advance into a Lead Engineer or Primary Engineering Team Leader role within 3–5 years. This is more than a technical role—it's'an opportunity to lead change, elevate engineering excellence, and leave a lasting impact on the region's'energy transformation. What will you do? You will deliver high‑voltage designs that strengthen grid reliability and support clean‑energy growth. You will produce buildable layouts and specifications that reduce construction issues and keep procurement on track. You will apply advanced engineering analysis to prevent failures and ensure long‑term system performance. You will lead design reviews and provide targeted site support to resolve issues early and avoid costly rework. You will collaborate with engineering, supply chain, and field teams to ensure seamless execution from design to energization. You will build customer confidence by presenting clear, dependable technical solutions that enable successful project delivery. Who you are? You have hands‑on experience with both outdoor and indoor GIS applications, including a solid understanding of the building infrastructure needed to support indoor GIS systems. You are skilled in CAD software, such as AutoCAD and/or MicroStation, and use these tools to produce accurate, high‑quality design deliverables. You hold a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering with at least five (5) years of experience, or a Master's degree in Electrical Engineering with at least three (3) years of experience. You ideally hold or are working toward a Professional Engineering (P.Eng.) certification. Must be fluent in both English and Spanish, with the ability to speak, read, write, and communicate effectively in both languages. What We Offer Competitive Salary: Enjoy a rewarding compensation package that reflects your contributions. Health, Dental, and Vision Coverage: Comprehensive benefits to support your well-being and that of your family. 401K with Employer Match: Invest in your future with our generous retirement savings plan. Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Access confidential support for personal and professional challenges. Paid Time Off (PTO): Recharge and relax with ample time off to maintain work-life balance. Learning and Development: Expand your skills through training programs and career-building opportunities. Mentorship Initiatives: Connect with experienced professionals for guidance, support, and career insight. Internal Mobility: Explore opportunities across departments and office locations to broaden your experience. Performance-Based Advancement: Grow your career through clear pathways tied to your achievements and impact. We are proud to announce that LinxonAmericas has been certified as a Great Place to Work® reflecting our commitment to fostering a diverse, inclusive environment that fuels innovation and teamwork.

review_candidates.title: Responsable de Programmes — Hôtellerie & Immobilier (H/F)
review_candidates.description: Maya Private Capital Investments (« MPCI ») est une société d'investissement basée à Genève, spécialisée dans les opérations de dette privée, de financement structuré et d'investissement en fonds propres dans le secteur immobilier, avec une expertise particulière dans l'hôtellerie. Dans le cadre du développement de son portefeuille d'actifs hôteliers et immobiliers — situés dans les principales destinations européennes ainsi que dans les Alpes françaises et suisses — MPCI recrute un(e) Responsable de Programme. En qualité de représentant(e) de la maîtrise d'ouvrage, il/elle pilote les programmes de construction, de rénovation et de repositionnement des actifs, de leur montage jusqu'à leur livraison et leur mise en exploitation, en garantissant la maîtrise des coûts, des délais et de la qualité. Contexte du poste Rattaché(e) à l'équipe Investissements & Asset Management et en interaction directe avec le comité d'investissement, le Responsable de Programme porte la responsabilité de la maîtrise d'ouvrage et du pilotage de bout en bout des opérations de construction et de repositionnement du portefeuille. Chef d'orchestre de chaque programme, il/elle coordonne l'ensemble des intervenants (maîtrise d'œuvre, AMO, entreprises tous corps d'état, bureaux d'études et de contrôle) et pilote le bilan de l'opération : coûts, budgets, planning, qualité d'exécution et respect des autorisations. Il/elle rend compte régulièrement de l'avancement et des risques aux organes de décision et contribue à la stratégie de création de valeur de chaque actif. Informations clés Lieu : Genève, Suisse Rattachement : Équipe Investissements & Asset Management Type de contrat : CDI, temps plein Prise de poste : Fin octobre / début novembre 2026 Déplacements : Fréquents — sites en travaux (Alpes françaises et suisses, grandes villes européennes) Missions principales Montage et direction des programmes Piloter, en qualité de représentant(e) de la maîtrise d'ouvrage, les programmes de construction, de rénovation et de repositionnement du portefeuille, de leur montage jusqu'à la livraison et la mise en exploitation. Définir et porter les objectifs de chaque programme : bilan financier de l'opération, planning directeur, cibles de coût, de délai et de qualité. Arbitrer les grandes orientations techniques et financières et sécuriser la faisabilité des opérations. Conception, études et autorisations Piloter les phases de programmation et de conception avec la maîtrise d'œuvre (architectes, bureaux d'études) et l'AMO. Optimiser les projets : faisabilité technique et économique, arbitrages de conception, choix constructifs. Constituer et suivre les autorisations administratives (permis de construire, déclarations, autorisations d'exploiter) auprès des autorités compétentes (urbanisme, ABF…). Direction des travaux et pilotage de chantier Diriger les travaux tous corps d'état : consultation et sélection des entreprises, passation des marchés, pilotage de l'exécution. Assurer l'ordonnancement, le pilotage et la coordination (OPC) du chantier ainsi que le suivi de la qualité d'exécution. Gérer les aléas (délais, surcoûts, travaux modificatifs, réserves), réceptionner les ouvrages et piloter la levée des réserves. Bilan d'opération : coûts, délais et budgets Établir et piloter le bilan financier de chaque programme (coûts de construction, honoraires, aléas, marges). Suivre les engagements, les situations et les décaissements ; sécuriser les enveloppes budgétaires et les jalons du planning. Challenger les chiffrages de la maîtrise d'œuvre et les offres des entreprises ; négocier les marchés et les avenants. Coordination des intervenants et interface exploitation Coordonner l'ensemble des parties prenantes : maîtrise d'œuvre, entreprises, bureaux d'études et de contrôle, assureurs, collectivités, etc. Intégrer les cahiers des charges des exploitants et des enseignes (standards de marque, mobilier et équipements — FF&E) et coordonner la mise en exploitation et l'ouverture des établissements. Reporting et création de valeur Rendre compte régulièrement de l'avancement, des budgets et des risques au comité d'investissement (notes, tableaux de bord, présentations PowerPoint). Contribuer à la stratégie de création de valeur des actifs et à la préparation des scénarios de sortie (cession, refinancement). Profil recherché Formation : ESTP ou école d'ingénieur du bâtiment / génie civil équivalente ; une formation complémentaire en immobilier, en gestion de projet ou en finance constitue un atout. Expérience : 1 à 3 ans en responsable de programmes ou en conduite de grands projets de construction, acquise au sein d'une entreprise générale ou d'un major du BTP (Eiffage, Léon Grosse, Bouygues, Vinci…) et/ou chez un promoteur-développeur, idéalement sur des actifs hôteliers ou immobiliers haut de gamme. Atout déterminant : avoir déjà exécuté un programme de bout en bout (du montage à la livraison), avec la pleine maîtrise du bilan d'opération, des coûts et des délais. Compétences techniques : maîtrise du bilan d'opération et des coûts de construction, des marchés de travaux, du planning et des pièces techniques (plans, CCTP, DQE / DPGF) ; solide connaissance du cadre réglementaire (urbanisme, permis, ABF). Leadership : capacité à diriger des équipes projet et à coordonner de multiples intervenants ; autorité naturelle, sens de la négociation et de la décision. Compétences bureautiques : parfaite maîtrise du Pack Office, en particulier Excel (bilans, modélisation) et PowerPoint (reporting). Langues : français et anglais courants indispensables, à l'écrit comme à l'oral ; la maîtrise de l'italien, de l'espagnol et/ou de l'allemand constitue un plus. Qualités personnelles : leadership, rigueur, autonomie, sens de l'organisation et goût du terrain ; aisance relationnelle, diplomatie et esprit entrepreneurial. Mobilité : disponibilité pour des déplacements fréquents sur les sites (Alpes françaises et suisses, grandes villes européennes) ; permis de conduire B requis ; autorisation de travailler en Suisse (ou éligibilité à un permis de travail). Ce que nous offrons La responsabilité pleine et entière de programmes hôteliers et immobiliers premium, du montage à la mise en exploitation. Un environnement entrepreneurial et responsabilisant, au sein d'une équipe d'investissement à taille humaine basée à Genève. Un poste à fort impact, à l'interface de la technique, de la finance et de la création de valeur immobilière, avec de réelles perspectives d'évolution.

review_candidates.title: Resident Engineer
review_candidates.description: Overview We are seeking a highly experienced Resident Engineer to lead and manage all site supervision activities for a prestigious large-scale development program in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Resident Engineer will serve as the Consultant's senior on-site representative, responsible for ensuring that construction works are executed in accordance with approved designs, contract requirements, quality standards, project schedules, and health, safety, and environmental regulations. The successful candidate will oversee multidisciplinary supervision teams, manage contractor performance, coordinate with stakeholders, and provide leadership throughout construction, testing, commissioning, and project handover phases. Your role Act as the Consultant's primary site representative and lead all project site supervision activities. Manage and supervise multidisciplinary engineering and inspection teams covering civil, structural, architectural, MEP, infrastructure, and specialist systems. Ensure construction works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, contract requirements, and applicable codes and standards. Monitor contractor performance, progress, productivity, and compliance with contractual obligations. Review and recommend approval of contractor submissions including shop drawings, method statements, material submittals, construction programs, and technical proposals. Monitor project schedules and ensure achievement of key project milestones and deliverables. Lead regular progress meetings, technical coordination meetings, and stakeholder workshops. Provide guidance and resolution for site-related technical challenges, design issues, and construction constraints. Review and respond to Requests for Information (RFIs), technical queries, and field modifications. Ensure implementation of approved Quality Assurance and Quality Control procedures across all project activities. Monitor compliance with Health, Safety, Security, and Environmental (HSSE) requirements and promote a strong safety culture. Coordinate with local authorities, utility providers, operators, and other stakeholders to facilitate project execution. Review and certify contractor progress reports, payment applications, and completed works. Support commercial and contracts teams in evaluating variations, claims, and Extension of Time (EOT) requests. Monitor risk management activities and ensure timely mitigation of project risks. Ensure compliance with Saudi Arabian regulations, authority approvals, and statutory requirements. Oversee testing, commissioning, integrated system testing, and operational readiness activities. Manage snagging, de-snagging, and handover processes to ensure successful project completion. Prepare and submit monthly project reports highlighting progress, quality, safety, commercial matters, and key project risks. Mentor and develop supervision staff while maintaining high standards of professional performance and technical excellence. About You Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Master's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or Project Management is preferred. Professional Engineer (PE), Chartered Engineer, PMP, or equivalent professional certification is highly desirable. Minimum 20+ years of overall professional experience in construction and engineering projects. Minimum 10 years of experience as a Resident Engineer on major building developments. Proven experience on large-scale buildings, convention centers, hospitality developments, luxury hotels, resorts, mixed-use developments, and commercial complexes. Extensive experience within Site Supervision Consultancy, PMC, or Engineering Consultancy environments. Strong knowledge of international building codes, construction standards, and engineering best practices. Demonstrated experience in FIDIC contract administration and construction management. Proven track record managing multidisciplinary project teams and complex stakeholder environments. Strong understanding of quality management systems, construction methodologies, testing, commissioning, and project handover requirements. Experience reviewing contractor claims, variations, schedule recovery plans, and commercial matters. Thorough understanding of project controls, construction sequencing, and risk management processes. Previous experience in Saudi Arabia or the GCC region is highly preferred. Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to effectively manage multiple contractors and interfaces on complex construction projects. Proficiency in project management and reporting software applications. Fluency in English is required; Arabic language skills are advantageous. Rewards & benefits Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. This Includes Tax-free salary. Life insurance coverage. Medical insurance. Annual leave balance. Company gratuity scheme. Discretionary bonus program. Annual flight contribution. Transportation & housing allowances. Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, familycare, personal health, fitness, and nutrition. Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make. About AtkinsRéalis We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people. Find out more.

review_candidates.description: Job Description: Regional Sales Director (RSD) Position Title: Regional Sales Director (RSD) Department: Sales Reports To: Executive Vice President of Sales Location: Remote (territory assigned at hire based on region and candidate location) Classification: W-2, full-time Why Echelon: Echelon is a full-service merchant services provider with 20 years in business, built on relationships that last. We own our entire 360 departmental infrastructure, including risk, underwriting, deployment, and US based support, all in house. Backed by Echelon Shield (PCI DSS Level 1 certified security) and attrition rates among the lowest in the industry, we operate in every major and medium market across the country. RSDs at Echelon build teams on a platform merchants stay with, which means residuals that compound rather than churn. Position Summary: The Regional Sales Director (RSD) is a key leadership role within Echelon, responsible for building, growing, and driving the performance of a regional sales team, potentially from the ground up. The RSD recruits and leads a team of 1099 sellers, working to ensure the team meets and exceeds sales targets while providing hands-on coaching and development. This role involves a combination of direct sales leadership, recruiting, strategic planning, and team development to contribute to the overall success of Echelon. Scope and Targets: Build the region, potentially from the ground up, to 10+ active producing agents within the first 12 months. Drive 35+ new merchant activations per month across the team by end of year one. This is a leadership-first role. Personal production is welcome and compensated but not required; the RSD is measured on team output. Key Responsibilities Sales Leadership: Manage and lead a regional team of sellers, ensuring that the team consistently meets or exceeds monthly sales targets. Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with overall company goals. Coaching and Development: Provide continuous coaching to sellers, enhancing their sales techniques, product knowledge, and overall effectiveness. Ensure that all team members are utilizing Echelon’s development resources, including training programs, sales tools, and performance analytics, to maximize their potential. Conduct regular check-ins and provide support to sellers in achieving their goals. Recruitment and Onboarding: Personally source, interview, and hire sales talent within the assigned region, and review the candidate pipeline with the Recruiting team and the Executive Vice President of Sales. Oversee the onboarding process for new sellers, ensuring they are fully equipped and integrated into the Echelon sales culture and process. Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development within the team. Performance Monitoring and Reporting: Regularly monitor and analyze sales performance metrics to identify trends, challenges, and opportunities for growth. Report on regional sales performance to senior sales leadership, providing insights, projections, and recommendations for improvement. Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, partners, and stakeholders within the region. Act as the primary point of contact for escalations and high-level client interactions within the region. Collaborate with the sales leadership team to share best practices and align strategies. Qualifications: Minimum of 5-7 years of sales experience, with at least 2 years in a leadership role managing sales teams. Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets, with experience in the payments or financial services industry preferred. Experience recruiting, managing, or producing within a 1099 sales model strongly preferred. Strong leadership and coaching abilities, with a focus on team development and performance improvement. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence at all levels of the organization. Strategic mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with a high level of accountability and ownership. Working Conditions: This position may require travel within the region to meet with sellers, clients, and attend industry events. The role offers flexibility, with the ability to work remotely and manage a geographically dispersed team. Compensation: Base salary of [$60,000 to $75,000], commensurate with experience. Override on team production, paid monthly. Residual participation on regional portfolio growth. Performance bonuses tied to recruiting and team activation targets. Comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off. Opportunities for career advancement within Echelon.

review_candidates.description: Organization Summary:  The vision of Edify is to see Flourishing Godly Nations, and we seek to accomplish this by improving and expanding sustainable Christ-centered education globally. Edify is a non-profit organization registered in the U.S. since 2009 and now has operations in 16 countries, including Burkina Faso, Bolivia, the Dominican Republic, Ecuador, Ghana, Guatemala, Kenya, Liberia, Nigeria, Uganda, Ethiopia, Peru, Sierra Leone, El-Salvador, Panama and Rwanda. Edify serves low-fee independent Christ-centered schools through three primary avenues, including access to capital, training, and education technology. Learn more at  www.edify.org   Location: Within the region   Start Date: October 1, 2026 Reports To: Regional VP, with matrix reporting into the VP of Human Resources  Salary Range: Commensurate with experience and education and competitive with other nonprofits Work Environment: This position will be a full-time position, based in any of our Edify Central American countries which currently includes Dominican Republic, El Salvador, Guatemala, and Panama with plans to expand into Mexico.  This role reports directly to the Regional Vice President of Central America with a matrix relationship to the Vice President of HR in the United States. The atmosphere of Edify is one where you can expect to perform widely varied tasks with various functional groups. Travel Expectations:  The position includes regional travel. Additionally, Edify holds an annual all-staff meeting, alternating in a US-based or international location each year. All Edify Staff are required to attend this meeting.  Position Summary: The Regional Human Resource Director will work closely with the Edify Country Leadership team to plan, lead, direct, develop, and coordinate the policies, activities of the Human Resource (HR) department in collaboration with the Edify core HR organization, ensuring the development the care of Edify staff consistent with our values and in compliance with local legal requirements.   Duties/Responsibilities: Collaborates with the Regional Vice President and Country’s senior leadership to understand the organization’s goals and strategy related to staffing, recruiting, and retention. Plans, leads, develops, coordinates, and implements policies, processes, training, initiatives, and surveys to support the Country’s human resource compliance and strategy needs, in line with Edify's global standards. Administers or oversees the administration of human resource programs including, but not limited to, compensation, benefits, and leave; disciplinary matters; disputes and investigations; performance and talent management; productivity, recognition, and morale; occupational health and safety; and training and development. Works with Country leadership to identify staffing and recruiting needs, including planning ahead for growth, as well as quick reaction for replacement due to any turnover; develops and executes best practices for hiring and talent management for the country needs. Conducts research and analysis of organizational trends including review of reports and metrics from the organization’s human resource information system (HRIS) or talent management system. Monitors and ensures the organization’s compliance with country/regional employment laws and regulations, and recommends best practices; reviews and modifies policies and practices to maintain compliance. Maintains knowledge of trends, best practices, regulatory changes, talent management, and employment law; applies this knowledge to communicate changes in policy, practice, and resources to upper management. Facilitates professional development, training, and certification activities Seeks to support CDs and RVP in addressing issues that may demotivate staff, as well as finding ways to further inspire staff to high levels of performance.  Performs other duties as required. Required Skills/Abilities:  Passion for the Mission of Edify High degree of character and integrity Strong HR practitioner with knowledge of all aspects of the HR function Thorough knowledge of employment-related laws and regulations. Knowledge of and experience with varied human resource information systems. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong supervisory and leadership skills. Ability to adapt to the needs of the organization and employees. Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate. Proficient with Google Suite or related software. Proficiency with or the ability to quickly learn the organization’s HRIS and talent management systems. Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred. Minimum eight years of human resource management experience required. Knowledge of employment law and regulations for the region  Non-profit experience and/or experience working with international staff or vendors preferred Ability to speak fluently in Spanish and English SHRM-CP or SHRM-SCP preferred.

review_candidates.title: Gerente de Proyecto
review_candidates.description: Rainforest Alliance busca un(a) Project Manager altamente motivado(a), orientado(a) a resultados y con sólida experiencia en gestión de proyectos de desarrollo sostenible, agroforestería y cadenas agrícolas, para liderar la implementación del proyecto: “Amazon Cacao Resilience: Roots of Prosperity for Cacao Farmers in San Martín, Peru” , financiado por EDEKA a través de su iniciativa Cocoa for Future. El proyecto tiene una duración de cinco años y busca fortalecer la resiliencia climática, económica y social de 3,000 productores de cacao en la región San Martín, mediante la implementación de sistemas agroforestales, restauración de paisajes productivos, fortalecimiento de capacidades técnicas, inclusión financiera y mejora de medios de vida. La intervención responde a desafíos críticos que enfrentan los productores de cacao, incluyendo la vulnerabilidad al cambio climático, la degradación de los sistemas productivos, las brechas de ingresos, el acceso limitado a financiamiento, y los riesgos asociados a la deforestación y al trabajo infantil. El proyecto promoverá la transición hacia sistemas agroforestales más resilientes mediante el establecimiento y manejo de especies forestales y de sombra, fortaleciendo simultáneamente las capacidades de los productores para mejorar la productividad, diversificar sus ingresos y aumentar la sostenibilidad de sus fincas. Asimismo, facilitará el acceso a servicios financieros y promoverá mecanismos de monitoreo y gestión de riesgos ambientales y sociales. El/la Project Manager será responsable de la planificación estratégica, implementación, coordinación técnica, monitoreo, gestión financiera y reporte integral del proyecto, asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos relacionados con: Agroforestería y restauración. Incremento de ingresos y resiliencia de productores. Inclusión financiera. Igualdad de género e inclusión social (GEDSI). Monitoreo de riesgos de deforestación y trabajo infantil. Cumplimiento de metas e indicadores acordados con EDEKA en el marco del proyecto. El puesto tendrá un rol central en la coordinación de equipos multidisciplinarios, instituciones públicas, organizaciones de productores, empresas compradoras, entidades financieras y otros aliados estratégicos, contribuyendo a generar impactos duraderos en la sostenibilidad de la cadena de cacao y en la conservación de los paisajes productivos de San Martín. Responsabilidades: Gestión Estratégica y Operativa del Proyecto Liderar la planificación e implementación operativa y estratégica del proyecto, conforme al cronograma, presupuesto y entregables establecidos en el contrato del proyecto, plan de trabajo y presupuesto aprobado. Liderar la coordinación de Rainforest Alliance con los actores claves (productores, asociaciones, cooperativas, empresas, instituciones gubernamentales, entre otros). Servir como el punto de contacto con el donante Velar por el cumplimiento de las políticas y lineamientos de EDEKA y RA Coordinar la integración de los componentes de agroforestería, inclusión financiera, ingresos dignos, GEDSI y monitoreo de riesgos. Implementar mecanismos de control de calidad y gestión adaptativa. Coordinar medidas de adaptación y mitigación frente a eventos climáticos como El Niño. Liderar la estrategia agroforestal y de restauración. Diseñar el SAF, lista de beneficiarios, metodologías de intervención. Gestionar la red de asistencia técnica y capacitación, garantizando la calidad de la asistencia técnica brindada a productores. Asegurar la incorporación del enfoque GEDSI en todas las actividades. Liderar la implementación de la estrategia de inclusión financiera. Liderar la estrategia de mitigación del trabajo infantil. Monitoreo, Evaluación y Reportes Supervisar el diseño metodológico de la línea base, encuestas, muestreo, levantamiento de información y análisis de resultados. Analizar los hallazgos de la línea base y desarrollar acciones en un plan operativo detallado para los cinco años del proyecto. Supervisar el sistema de monitoreo en coordinación con el MEL de RA Peru. Elaborar y presentar los informes trimestrales, anuales y finales de progreso técnico y financiero, según los requerimientos del donante y RA Coordinar auditorías, aseguramientos, y responder ante solicitudes de revisión. Generar contenido sobre los principales resultados, notas importantes, historias de éxito, entre otros, como insumo para su posterior publicación en las redes por el área de comunicaciones de RA; Comunicación y Reportes Elaborar informes trimestrales, anuales y finales. Documentar lecciones aprendidas y casos de éxito. Coordinar el desarrollo de materiales de comunicación. Apoyar la visibilidad de los resultados del proyecto ante EDEKA y otros aliados. Otras actividades solicitadas por el Director de País. Requisitos: Formación Académica Formación en agronomía, forestal, economía agraria, desarrollo rural, ciencias ambientales o afines. Deseable maestría en Gestión de Proyectos, sistemas agroforestales, cacao, certificación u otro relacionado con el proyecto. Experiencia Mínimo 8 años en gestión de proyectos. Mínimo 5 años trabajando en cacao, agroforestería, restauración o cadenas sostenibles. Experiencia gestionando fondos de cooperación internacional. Experiencia liderando equipos multidisciplinarios. Experiencia en gestión financiera y presupuestal. Experiencia trabajando con organizaciones locales como, comunidades nativas y locales, cooperativas, asociaciones, entre otros. Habilidades y Conocimientos I nglés fluido (escrito y oral) obligatorio , para interacción directa con el donante y áreas globales en RA, empresas internacionales, elaboración de informes, etc. Disponibilidad para residir en San Martín con viajes periódicos a Lima. Capacidad analítica, de redacción técnica y liderazgo en entornos multiculturales y complejos Dominio de herramientas y plataformas digitales para gestión de proyectos (Excel, Outlook, etc.).
